**brief:** the `test-bodies` probe now runs inside the brief's own process as a Rust step (`execution_brief/steps/`): no interpreter start and no `rg`, same blocks, same gating and budget. The installed `test-bodies` script is no longer started; `pixel plugin disable test-bodies` still switches it off. `workspace-overview` runs as a step as well (the manifests of a Cargo, npm, pnpm, Go or uv workspace), with the script as its oracle. So does `overview-answer-evidence` (what a named Cargo crate exposes, depends on and includes). And `cand-k-member-manifest` (the manifest and files of the member a crate question names). And `doc-sections` (the documentation sections a question names), for which a step is now told the question kind. And `name-files` (the definitions, files and modules a question's words spell), which walks the tree with the `ignore` crate instead of running `rg`.
**brief:** the `cand-j-chain` probe now runs inside the brief's own process as a Rust step (`execution_brief/steps/cand_j_chain.rs`), reading the code graph through the daemon socket in process (`steps/graph.rs`) instead of starting `pixel` twice: same blocks, same gating and budget. The installed script is no longer started; `pixel plugin disable cand-j-chain` still switches it off.
